entities.name: Franciscan Monastery in Pula
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Monastery and Church of St. Francis in Pula, Croatia, are located on the western slope of the Pula hill, halfway between the Forum and the medieval fortress at the top, on the site where previously was the early Christian complex of St. John the Baptist.
